posts.text: KJØP 125 KR - SB1 MARKETS 27.08.26  - In its 2Q26 report, Kitron wrote that they see “the deepest 2026-2028 opportunity pipeline in our history”. We see the same.  Our proprietary tracker points to high single-digit growth excl. Defence and DeltaNordic (48% of revenues) in 2026 and double-digit into 1H27 and the three latest Defence order backlog conversion figures points towards ~125% growth in 2026 and +30% YoY growth in 1H27 (46% of revenues). Consequently, we are positioned above high-end of guidance in 2026 and above consensus in 2026-2028 (3-13% on EBIT). Therefore, without any major disruptions in the electronics supply chain (which is the case currently according to several of our market sources), we see an underlying customer demand that support a higher outlook. Coupled with i) some 1%/4.4%/6.7% positive EBIT revisions in 2026-2028 post 2Q26, ii) 15x/11x/9x EV/EBIT in the same period with iii) net cash, we see no reasons to deviate from our current recommendation. Thus, we reiterate our Buy recommendation and NOK125 target price and see the current weakness as a great buying opportunity. • Our proprietary tracker continue to support rebound excl. Defence and DeltaNordic. In its 2Q26 report, Kitron wrote that they see “the deepest 2026-2028 opportunity pipeline in our history”. We see the same. Our proprietary tracker points to high single-digit growth excl. Defence and DeltaNordic (48% of revenues) in 2026 and double-digit into 1H27 and the three latest Defence order backlog conversion figures points towards ~125% growth in 2026 and +30% YoY growth in 1H27 (46% of revenues). • 1-7% EBIT and 5-11% EPS changes post 2Q26. Following a solid 2Q26, we lift our estimates by 1-7% on EBIT and 5-11% on EPS. This is primarily related to Defence, driven by supportive development in backlog conversion, which points to ~125% YoY growth in 2026 and +30% YoY growth in 1H27. Consequently, we model with EPS of NOK4.2/5.4/6.8 in 2026-2028, which position us 3-13% above consensus on EBIT in 2026-2028 and 1-11% on EPS and above high-end of company guidance for the current year. • Reiterate our Buy recommendation and NOK125 target price. Kitron trades at a 2026-2028 EV/EBIT of 15x/11x/9x and a corresponding P/E multiple of 20x/16x/12x in the same period. However, at the same time, the company operate with a net cash position, which include ~50% of EPS in dividends in 2027 and 2028 on our estimates. This makes room for further M&A like BB Electronics and DeltaNordic, but that is not included in our estimates. Hence, the company accumulate a significant amount of cash supported by 75-80% cash conversion and a capital light business model (capex around 2-2.5% of sales). Vis 1 kommentar til
